description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ampitiya, Monaragala D/S Division, Monaragala District (25/0041)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with owner information, parcel numbers, extents, and legal conditions related to land ownership. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters.
